intro.text: Bitcoin does not have any authority. That's not a flaw. That's the design.

bridge_01.text: Next, from Natalie Brunell's show: what does a system with no one in charge have to get right?

bridge_02.text: No ruler. Just rules nobody gets to bend. That's the idea, and it's the part most people still miss when they look at Bitcoin.

signoff.text: Clips today from Saifedean Ammous, What Bitcoin Did, and Natalie Brunell. Go follow them for sharp Bitcoin insights every week. Links below.
